content: First heartbeat for monetization team. operator-inputs.json is entirely unpopulated: cash, monthlyBurn (aiApi/infrastructure/saas/tooling), timeAllocation.product, timeAllocation.ops are all pending-operator. servicesRevenue.*, servicesTime, timeAllocation.services, subscriptions.mrr are not-applicable-pre-launch. No numeric snapshot is computable until the operator populates operator-inputs.json. Runway, default-alive gap, and burn categories all emit pending-operator. All FINANCIAL_MODEL.md key assumptions (1-5) still hold — no data yet to invalidate them. No deltas (no prior snapshot). No decisions raised; the deliverable is the Inputs-needed list in the HANDOFF. Pending-telemetry fields remain: subscription MRR by tier/bundle (TELEMETRY_ROADMAP Gap 2, LPBS/Stripe), retention/churn/LTV (post-launch), infra costs auto-aggregation (scenario-to-cloud gap).

First catalog-strategist heartbeat. Queue at 0 pending. No catalog deltas since nothing was previously tracked. Active SKUs: business (active, 0 paying subs, 0 headliners shipped). Headliners web-console and git-control-tower both in-progress per initiative list (GCT has 6+ active initiatives: ai-provenance, github-integration, merge, pre-commit-security, commit-initiative-linking, release-pipeline; web-console has audio-platform initiative). Amplifiers agent-manager and workspace-sandbox both in-progress (Agent Sandbox Audit Foundation 0/5, Protected Agent Sandboxing 0/3). Future-headliner swarm-manager remains blocked by agent-manager/workspace-sandbox; its own Graph Workspace (5/7) and Feature Parity (4/7) show progress but not the deploy-readiness gate. Trigger evaluation — all candidate SKUs and tiers fail their revisit triggers because paying-subscriber count is 0 (fixed, per FINANCIAL_MODEL and business.md current-status): lifestyle (needs 50 subs + 2 lifestyle scenarios), property-services (50 subs + prospect signal), elder-care/family-with-kids (parent lifestyle not active), Tier 2 (needs subs + account sign-in + license gateway; none exist), Tier 3 (gated on Tier 2), Tier 4 (north-star). No scenarios cross the headliner threshold. Sku-map roles remain accurate. Single load-bearing bottleneck: agent-manager stabilization — it amplifies GCT-headliner AND gates swarm-manager future-headliner; unblocking it is the biggest catalog-motion lever available. 0 decisions raised.

First scout scan. Pool was empty; seeded 6 candidates from capability-arrival signal (no operator vision-walk signal yet — vision-walk-prep has not run, director-swarm knowledge only shows portfolio metrics from early April). Signal source for all 6 is self-generated from the 97-scenario inventory in scenarios/.

Ideas captured (all status=idea, honestly flagged):
- Creator / content-business bundle (new-base-bundle): cluster of 7+ creator-stack scenarios (seo-optimizer, landing-manager, landing-page-business-suite, campaign-content-studio, brand-manager, funnel-builder, social-media-scheduler). Distinct audience from business bundle. Trigger: business bundle >=25 subs AND >=4 scenarios shipped.
- AI quality and red-team add-on (business addon): prompt-injection-arena + llm-evaluator + scenario-auditor + scenario-completeness-scoring + development-toolchain-validator. AI-liability regulatory tailwind is external but uncited for this entry. Trigger: >=15 subs AND (both scenarios shipped OR >=2 prospect asks).
- Multi-platform publisher add-on (business addon): scenario-to-desktop/android/ios/extension/mcp/cloud + deployment-manager + app-monitor. Natural expansion for agent-manager-amplified headliner subscribers. Trigger: >=25 subs AND >=3 scenario-to-X shipped.
- Smart-home / household-ops add-on (lifestyle addon): home-automation + device-sync-hub + lifestyle-dashboard + calendar + notification-hub + notes + maintenance-orchestrator. Complements but does not duplicate elder-care/family-with-kids. Trigger: lifestyle bundle active AND (2 scenarios shipped OR Tier 4 path activates).
- AI-eval services-line candidate: done-for-you engagement that productizes into the AI quality add-on. Clean conversion path per REVENUE_LINES.md. Trigger: 2 eval scenarios deployable as thin tools AND 1 paid-pilot prospect.
- Landing-page + funnel DFY services-line: uses landing-page-business-suite + funnel-builder + campaign-content-studio. Proof-of-capability for creator bundle candidate. Trigger: 2 scenarios deployable AND creator-bundle candidate reaches doc status.

Strongest signal: the creator/content-business bundle — 7+ scenarios cluster around one audience that is both addressable and habitually pays for tools, but none are shipped yet and the business bundle has zero paying users, so promotion is not warranted today.

Weakest signal: smart-home add-on — lifestyle bundle itself is candidate, so it's at least two promotions removed from activation; captured for pool durability only.

Deliberately NOT captured:
- Enterprise IT / internal-platform bundle (vrooli-bridge + vrooli-emulator + command-center + deployment-manager etc.) — too ambitious, hits operator time budget, no signal.
- Tier 4 / hardware ideas — north-star, operator-initiation-only per policy.
- Individual paid micro-apps (palette-gen, picker-wheel, bedtime-story-generator, elo-swipe) — revenue-line question rather than SKU-candidate question; not in scout charter today.

No direct catalog-promotion decisions raised. No prior scout-scan knowledge entry to supersede (first entry).

First contrarian heartbeat. Team queue: 0 pending decisions. No proposals to challenge.

Reviewed for fresh proposals:
- financial-tracker ledger snapshot (knw-1776967259105788561): all metrics honestly labeled pending-operator / pending-telemetry / aspirational / not-applicable-pre-launch. No hallucinated-metrics (FM5) exposure. Cleared.
- catalog-strategist catalog snapshot (knw-1776969102742586321): 0 catalog-promotion / mapping / retirement decisions raised; all trigger evaluations correctly cite paying-subs=0 as the No-fire root. No catalog-sprawl (FM1) or premature-tier-activation (FM2) exposure. Cleared.
- opportunity-scout pool seeding (6 entries in opportunities.jsonl: creator bundle, AI-quality add-on, multi-platform publisher add-on, smart-home add-on, AI-eval services candidate, landing+funnel DFY services candidate). Status=idea, not proposals-for-promotion. Scored all 6 anyway:
  - FM1 catalog-sprawl: every candidate has a concrete revisit trigger (subs count + capability-shipped conditions). Cleared.
  - FM3 services-trap: both services candidates carry all four mandatory attributes (hypothesis, fixed-duration pilot [6-8 wks eval, 2-4 wks landing], productization target [add-on or subscription], sunset/convert clause). Cleared.
  - FM4 retention-blind: every candidate has explicit retention hypothesis alongside acquisition hypothesis. Cleared.
  - FM5 hallucinated-metrics: AI-regulatory tailwind is self-flagged 'uncited-for-this-entry'; TAM bands (S/M/L) are classification not claim. Cleared.
  - FM6 positioning-drift: none frame subscription as paywalling core or OSS-path as revenue leak. Cleared.
  - FM7 marketing-default: all candidates lean on agent-driven in-workflow retention (context accumulation, brand-voice learning, household state). Cleared.
- market-validator: market-scans.jsonl empty (no scan yet this period). Nothing to review.

Aging scan: 0 pending decisions, nothing to age-out or supersede.

Own-context cap: 0 of 3 decision-rejection-proposed / framework-update pending.

No challenge notes written, no rejection recommendations raised, no framework-update candidates identified. Quiet is valid — per SOUL.md, contrarian does not manufacture objections.
